All registration must be done online via cubingchina.com.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee.
For foreign participants, if you can't pay the fee online via Alipay, please contact the delegate by E-mail right after you finish the onlineregistration. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. 
Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.

items.name: Fiji Nationals 2025
items.information:
First official WCA competition in Fiji.

The fastest Fiji competitor in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Fiji.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Fiji nationality can win prizes and honours.

## Welcome to the MyFamilyFest Speedcubing Challenge 2025!
[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MyFamilyFestSpeedcubingChallenge2025)

**Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.**

**If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Updates & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MyFamilyFestSpeedcubingChall2025#63049-updates-announcements) and the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MyFamilyFestSpeedcubingChall2025#63050-new-competitors) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.**
•
Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
•
***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.information:
### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025#63641-registro) para conocer los medios de pago.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025/register)
 
### **IMPORTANT**
  You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.
  
*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025#63641-registro) to know the payment methods.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloCubingFest2025/register)
